question: After the skipped-worker upload defect is fixed and every exact-head gate passes, should this credential-boundary replacement enter the guarded production rollout?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes where credentials exist, which receipts authorize mutation, and how production repair failures recover; that operational acceptance cannot be inferred solely from code review or CI.

options.title: Approve guarded rollout after repair
options.body: Fix the no-run upload condition, rerun all exact-head gates, and merge under the documented guarded rollout.

options.title: Pause boundary migration
options.body: Keep the current repair workflow until additional end-to-end recovery and no-op-path evidence is available.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded rollout after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the no-run upload condition, rerun all exact-head gates, and merge under the documented guarded rollout.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion records this person performing reconciliation and conditionally authorizing the guarded rollout pending exact-head gates.
